exceptions.decision: Decision 1, adopted by the product owner 2026-09-27 (relayed ChatGPT review of summary documents; not a legal opinion)

conditions: unmodified: no patches, forks, vendoring or relabelling

a dependency path not via the adapter
exceptions.otherLgpl: Any other LGPL package remains DENIED pending its own review

exceptions.name: pako
exceptions.decision: LIC-R1, adopted by the product owner 2026-09-27 (repair-pass directive; not a legal opinion)
obligations: MIT (JavaScript port, Copyright (C) 2014-2017 Vitaly Puzrin and Andrei Tuputcyn): include the copyright and permission notice in all copies or substantial portions
Zlib (zlib-derived code, (C) 1995-2013 Jean-loup Gailly and Mark Adler): do not misrepresent the origin; mark altered source plainly; do not remove or alter the notice in any source distribution
use unmodified: no pnpm patch, fork or vendoring (a modification would also trigger Zlib clause 2 and needs re-review)
exceptions.scope: exact name@version and integrity only. MIT stays allowed and Zlib stays REVIEW in policy for every other package; no broad licence-scan exemption
exceptions.enforcement: tools/license-check (APPROVED_EXACT): licence expression, lockfile integrity, not patched, both notices byte-identical to the installed package
reviewTriggers: any distribution of software copies (notices must ship with it)
